title: Klein Bottle Figure-8 Immersion
formula: r(u, v) = ((r + cos(u/2)sin(v) - sin(u/2)sin(2v))cos(u), (r + cos(u/2)sin(v) - sin(u/2)sin(2v))sin(u), sin(u/2)sin(v) + cos(u/2)sin(2v))
latex: x = \left(r + \cos\frac{u}{2}\sin v - \sin\frac{u}{2}\sin 2v\right)\cos u,\quad y = \left(r + \cos\frac{u}{2}\sin v - \sin\frac{u}{2}\sin 2v\right)\sin u,\quad z = \sin\frac{u}{2}\sin v + \cos\frac{u}{2}\sin 2v
parametric_fn: (u, v, target) => { const r = 1.8; const cu = Math.cos(u), su = Math.sin(u); const cu2 = Math.cos(u * 0.5), su2 = Math.sin(u * 0.5); const cv = Math.cos(v), sv = Math.sin(v); const s2v = Math.sin(2.0 * v); const x = (r + cu2 * sv - su2 * s2v) * cu; const y = (r + cu2 * sv - su2 * s2v) * su; const z = su2 * sv + cu2 * s2v; target.set(x, z, -y).multiplyScalar(0.7); }
